classification.difficultyReason: Identify the vertex of a supplied downward-opening quadratic as the maximum, calculate its time, and substitute to obtain the height.

content.prompt:
Justify any conclusions and/or assumptions made in the context of the problem.

A ball is thrown upward and its height in metres after $t$ seconds is given by $h=-5t^2+20t+1$. Find the maximum height reached by the ball.

answer.short: The maximum height is $21\text{ m}$, reached after $2\text{ s}$.
answer.worked:
$h$ is a downward-opening quadratic, so its vertex gives the maximum height.
$$\begin{align*}t_{\text{maximum}}&=-\frac{20}{2(-5)}\\t_{\text{maximum}}&=2\\h(2)&=-5(2)^2+20(2)+1\\h(2)&=21\end{align*}$$
The ball reaches a maximum height of $21\text{ m}$ after $2\text{ s}$.
